photos.file: Spix's Macaw (Cyanopsitta spixii) at Jurong Bird Park in Singapore.jpg
photos.desc: Two captive individuals of the Spix's Macaw, which is thought to be extinct in the wild. Photo taken at the Jurong Bird Park, a zoo in Singapore (a separate park of the Singapore Zoo).
